# viettelcloud_subnet (Data Source)

Get a Viettel Cloud subnet by ID, name, CIDR, VPC, or region.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Lookup subnet by ID
data "viettelcloud_subnet" "by_id" {
  id = "xxxxxxxx-xxxx-xxxx-xxxx-xxxxxxxxxxxx"
}

# Lookup subnet by name within a VPC
data "viettelcloud_subnet" "by_name_and_vpc" {
  name     = "my-subnet"
  vpc_name = "my-vpc"
}

# Lookup subnet by CIDR and region
data "viettelcloud_subnet" "by_cidr_and_region" {
  cidr   = "10.0.1.0/24"
  region = "vn-central-1"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `cidr` (String) IPv4 network CIDR to filter by, e.g. 10.0.1.0/24.
- `id` (String) Subnet ID (UUID). Exactly one subnet must match.
- `name` (String) Name of the subnet to filter by.
- `region` (String) Region name where the subnet resides to filter by.
- `vpc_id` (String) VPC ID (UUID) containing the subnet to filter by.
- `vpc_name` (String) Name of the VPC containing the subnet to filter by.

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String) Timestamp when the subnet was created (RFC3339).
- `description` (String) Optional description of the subnet.
- `display_name` (String) Display name assigned by the platform.
- `updated_at` (String) Timestamp when the subnet was last updated (RFC3339).
